system.description: The old Tremere curse was stronger in you than in most of your clanmates, and ur-Shulgi's Breaking did not fully cleanse you. You share your caste's thirst for Cainite blood, but for you it remains a poison: you take one health level of lethal, unsoakable damage (no Fortitude or similar power may reduce it) for every Blood Trait of non-Assamite Cainite vitae you ingest, though the Blood Traits still enter your Blood Pool after the damage is inflicted. On the plus side, you gain one free retest on every Self-Control challenge dealing with the warrior caste's vitae addiction. If you are a sorcerer or vizier, this Flaw is worth one additional Trait (4 total), but you also gain the warrior caste's vitae addiction weakness in addition to your own caste's weakness.
